items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: I interrupted when you were talking about Buddy Bolden for a minute was there anything else you really had?

ctx.x: You see from generation to generation they always would relate us what they had their past life was
I interrupted when you were talking about Buddy Bolden for a minute was there anything else you really had?
I'd like to ask... I'd like to try and find out how the band sounded did they sound like any band today or how many pieces were in there?
